◆生成这个角色的三视图，包含正面，侧面，背面，灰色背景
◆生成这个角色的四视图，从左到右分别为：面部特写，全身正面，全身侧面，全身背面，灰色背景

◆提取图中完整人物，仅保留人物，去除背景，透明背景

◆对这张老照片进行完整修复与上色：彻底去除画面中所有划痕、缺损、污渍与霉点，将模糊的面部五官、衣物与背景重建为清晰锐利的高清细节，恢复自然的皮肤纹理、皱纹层次、头发丝与布料质感；随后为整张照片上自然真实的色彩，还原为干净通透的彩色人像，肤色红润真实、衣物呈现可信的固有色，整体色彩明亮干净、清晰通透，如同清晰彩色照片；完整保留人物的脸型、五官比例与相对位置、表情与神态、姿态以及衣物的款式结构，保持构图、取景与画面缩放完全不变，人物始终为同一可辨认的本人。

◆对图中的产品进行精修，去除产品所有划痕、缺损、污渍、锈迹与杂质，恢复产品崭新的状态，清晰呈现产品原有的材质与结构细节，精细的光照效果与质感，表面干净。构图保持原图产品摆放与视角不变。
同时对产品进行抠图，将产品从场景中提取出来，输出仅保留产品，透明背景。保留产品完整主体，边缘干净利落、无残留背景色边或锯齿。

◆参考图二的风格，生成一张电影海报，包含图二和图一两个人物背靠背，主题文字为：新的征程，暗金色书法大字

◆让图一的人物穿上图二的衣服

◆根据图中人物制作九宫格表情包，表情依次为：开心，吐舌，愤怒，悲伤，生气，恐惧，哭泣，微笑，害羞。最终输出包含9个表情的九宫格图片

◆按照图中人物的1/7比例，在写实的风格和环境下，制作一个商业化的全身逼真人物模型。保持人物姿势不变，将人物模型放置在电脑桌上，使用圆形透明亚克力底座，底座上不带任何文字。在电脑屏幕上，展示人物模型的ZBrush建模过程。在电脑屏幕旁边，放置一个印有原画的BANDAI风格玩具包装盒。

◆基于提供的 IP 形象，设计 9 种风格各异的姿势，涵盖站立、坐姿、动态动作（如跳跃、挥手）、静态姿态（如托腮、叉腰）等不同类型，每种姿势需贴合该 IP 的核心特征与性格特质，清晰呈现 IP 在各姿势下的整体形态与细节，最终输出包含9个姿势的九宫格图片。

◆图1的人物手里拿着图2的产品进行展示，专业影棚，光线和色调符合所在场景环境

◆根据图片内容生成漫画故事，九格漫画，文本气泡中带有中文剧情，有特写与大场景切换，分镜之间避免雷同，Q版风格

◆把图2的人物头部和发型替换到图1，肤色，比例，和图1保持一致

◆让图一的人物和图二的人物，拥抱在一起，在城市街道

◆生成四格电影分镜，全程人物形象保持统一：
第1格：少女单膝跪在粗糙黑岩石上，拉满弓弦，目光锁定远处目标，蓄势待发，神情严肃，风吹长发。
第2格：松开弓弦，弓身震动，箭矢向前射出，长发猛烈飞扬。
第3格：特写镜头，发光箭矢带着淡青色光尾破空飞行，背景里少女虚化，箭矢带动态速度模糊。
第4格：少女望向远方，远处目标迸发出橙色小型爆炸，神情放松平静。

◆Generate three-view projections of this character, including front, side, and back views, on a gray background
◆Generate four-view projections of this character, from left to right: close-up of the face, full-body front view, full-body side view, and full-body back view, all on a gray background

◆Extract the complete figure from the image, retaining only the figure and removing the background to create a transparent background

◆Completely restore and colorize this old photograph: thoroughly remove all scratches, damage, stains, and mold spots from the image; reconstruct blurred facial features, clothing, and background into clear, sharp, high-definition details; restore natural skin texture, layers of wrinkles, individual strands of hair, and the texture of fabrics; Then, apply natural and realistic colors to the entire photo, restoring it to a clean and translucent color portrait with a healthy, realistic complexion and clothing that displays believable inherent colors. The overall color scheme is bright, clean, clear, and translucent, resembling a crisp color photograph; The subject’s facial shape, facial feature proportions and relative positions, expressions and demeanor, posture, as well as the style and structure of their clothing are fully preserved, while the composition, framing, and zoom level remain completely unchanged—ensuring the subject remains the same, recognizable individual throughout.

◆ Perform detailed retouching on the product in the image to remove all scratches, defects, stains, rust, and impurities, restoring the product to its brand-new condition. Clearly showcase the product’s original material and structural details, along with refined lighting effects and texture, ensuring a clean surface. The composition retains the original product placement and perspective.
At the same time, perform image masking on the product to extract it from the scene, outputting only the product on a transparent background. Retain the entire product subject with clean, crisp edges, free of any residual background color or jagged edges.

◆ Referencing the style of Image 2, create a movie poster featuring the two figures from Images 1 and 2 standing back-to-back. The theme text should read: “A New Journey,” written in large, dark gold calligraphy.

◆ Dress the character from Image 1 in the clothes shown in Image 2.

◆ Create a 3x3 grid of emojis based on the character in the image. The expressions, in order, are: happy, sticking out tongue, angry, sad, upset, scared, crying, smiling, and shy. The final output should be a 3x3 grid image containing all 9 emojis.

◆Create a commercial-grade, photorealistic full-body character model of the figure shown in the image at a 1/7 scale, using a realistic style and setting. Keep the character’s pose unchanged and place the model on a computer desk using a circular, transparent acrylic base with no text on it. Display the ZBrush modeling process for the character on the computer screen. Place a BANDAI-style toy box printed with the original artwork next to the computer screen.

◆Based on the provided IP character, design 9 poses in distinct styles, covering standing, sitting, dynamic actions (such as jumping or waving), and static poses (such as resting the chin on the hand or placing hands on hips). Each pose must align with the IP’s core characteristics and personality traits, clearly presenting the character’s overall form and details in each pose. The final output should be a 9-panel grid image featuring all 9 poses.

◆The character in Image 1 holds the product from Image 2 for display. The scene must be shot in a professional studio with lighting and color tones that match the surrounding environment.

◆Create a comic story based on the images: a nine-panel comic with Chinese dialogue in speech bubbles. Include transitions between close-ups and wide shots, ensuring each panel is distinct from the others, in a chibi style.

◆Replace the head and hairstyle of the character in Image 2 with those from Image 1, ensuring skin tone and proportions match those in Image 1.

◆ Have the character from Image 1 and the character from Image 2 embrace each other on a city street.

◆ Create a four-panel movie storyboard, maintaining consistent character designs throughout:
Panel 1: A young girl kneels on one knee on a rough black rock, drawing the bowstring back fully. Her gaze is fixed on a distant target as she prepares to shoot, her expression serious, with the wind blowing through her long hair.
Panel 2: She releases the bowstring; the bow vibrates as the arrow shoots forward, her long hair flying wildly.
Panel 3: Close-up shot—the glowing arrow flies through the air with a pale blue trail; the girl in the background is blurred, and the arrow shows motion blur.
Panel 4: The girl looks into the distance as a small orange explosion erupts from the distant target; her expression is relaxed and calm.
